LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultRosterEmpty: Add at least one beast to the pack.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultRosterLaunched: An assault pack of {1} beasts is moving against {0}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultArrivalTitle: The pack has reached its target
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultArrivalText: The assault pack has reached {0}. It carries {1} beasts with a combined strength of {2}; the settlement's defence is rated at {3}.\n\nFight the battle yourself, or let the pack resolve it without loading the map?
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultArrivalNotHostile: {0} is not hostile to you: attacking will make them hostile.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultArrivalTimeout: The pack will wait {0} for orders. Without an answer it fights the battle on its own.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultArrivalTimedOut: The pack at {0} waited too long for orders and resolved the battle itself.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultBattleStarted: The pack landed at {0}: {1} beasts are on the map. The map is held until you withdraw them - select the settlement on the world map and press "Withdraw pack".
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultWithdrawDesc: Form the return caravan: pick which beasts leave and what they drag along. Once confirmed the map closes and the pack carries the loot home to its outpost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultWithdrawDone: The pack withdrew: {0} beasts returned and {1} stack(s) of loot reached the outpost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultCaravanCountTip: How much to carry off the battlefield.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultCaravanMassTip: Each beast hauls {0} kg per point of body size. Downed beasts carry nothing.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultCaravanCollapseWarning: The battle map collapses the moment the caravan leaves: anything you do not take is lost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultCaravanOverloaded: The pack cannot haul that much: {0} kg against a capacity of {1} kg.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultCaravanAbandonConfirm: Beasts left behind collapse with the map and are lost. Abandon {0} beast(s) on the battlefield?
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultCaravanSent: The caravan set out: {0} beasts and {1} stack(s) of cargo are travelling to the outpost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultCaravanArrived: The caravan reached the outpost: {0} beasts joined the stock and {1} stack(s) went into storage.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultCaravanNoOutpost: The home outpost is gone: the pack and its loot are lost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultCaravanDropConfirm: Drop {0} along the way? The cargo is lost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultCaravanDropSelectedDesc: Drop all selected cargo along the way. It is lost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultCaravanDropSelectedConfir: Drop the selected cargo ({0}) along the way? It is lost.
LanguageData.FB_DevAssaultProbeDesc: Measure the map's defence and our pack in vanilla combat points. The report goes to the log and to a window.
LanguageData.FB_DevAssaultProbeReport:
Defence: {0} pawns, {1} points (turrets: {2})
Pack: {3} pawns, {4} points
Pack/defence ratio: {5}
Reference: vanilla generation spends 1150-1600 points on settlement defenders regardless of faction.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultRetargetDesc: Choose another settlement: the pack turns around and marches on it, even if it is already returning with loot. In a manual battle the pack's cargo is left at the map edge where it entered and can be picked up again by the return caravan. In an automatic battle the cargo stays with the pack and is lost with it on defeat. After the battle the pack returns to its outpost on its own.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultReturnDesc: Abort the march and return to the pack's outpost, or choose another one. The beasts and loot settle in the chosen outpost, which becomes the pack's home.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultReturnNoOutposts: There are no outposts the pack can reach.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultOrderNoRoute: The pack cannot reach that place.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultHaltDesc: Stop the pack where it stands until a new order, so it does not march for nothing. Changing the target or ordering a return lifts the halt.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultHaltAwaitingBattle: The pack is already at its target and awaits the battle decision.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultCargoDropped: The pack's cargo was left at the map edge: {0} stack(s).
